items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Directory read, overrides win, brief_dir persisted and re-verified, file route and adopt unchanged, refusals for hash/approval/fixture, anchors checked in code, FR Names compared, stale update-step prose fixed. brief_intake.py 295 lines.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: BriefRefused with closed codes and exit 3 (5 in write_run_config); no fallback to the self-attested hash once run_config exists; OS/lock errors reported structurally.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Hash and approval verified before write-config, resume and answers; recorded hash never re-baselined; config drift refused; fixture approval gated on the env switch; trust-on-first-use limit documented. Known limit: read-then-verify narrows but does not close TOCTOU.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests cover each refusal path, resume, tamper with rewritten hash, ordinary free text staying a description; gate run as a real subprocess.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One directory scan per verification; small files only.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New logic in two new modules under 300 lines; brief_intake gets a routing hook only; ADR-045 loaders by file path.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: run_config producer (record) and consumers (verify, project mode, orchestrator readers) round-tripped; CRLF and BOM brief.md probed; CLI end to end.
